config.name: gapfinder-v1
config.frozen_before_run: 2026-09-25T04:30Z (written before any Gapfinder model was trained or scored)
config.objective: Predict fault pixels NOT already in labels.tif. Official staff answers: the known-fault scoring mask is pixel-exact and identical to the training labels; 'new fault' includes newly mapped geometry of existing systems; predictions near (not on) known traces are fully penalized.
config.buffer_rationale: 30 px feature radius + ridge smoothing/NMS support (~5 px) + 3 px metric kernel = 38 px < 48 px
config.fold_rotation_note: Riftline tuned on fold 0 and read its audit on fold 1. Gapfinder evaluates only on folds 2 and 3, which were never used as Riftline evaluation regions.

arms.role: new: supplied labels plus independent USGS SGMC fault traces in the TRAINING folds only
new: learns only from faults the supplied catalogue does not contain

config.halo_meaning: zero emitted pixels with 0 < distance-to-known <= halo; known pixels themselves are always 0 (masked by the scorer)
config.tip_meaning: straight along-strike ray beyond each free end of the supplied fault skeleton, direction from its last 8 skeleton pixels
config.emission: binary oriented-ridge (Hessian NMS) - linear-fractional DTI favours binary emission

proxies.gap: SGMC fault pixels >= 3.2 px from any known pixel (legacy proxy value 2)
proxies.all: all SGMC fault pixels not exactly on a known pixel (proxy values 1 or 2, minus known)
proxies.evaluation_mask: template-valid AND NOT known AND fold interior (competition-faithful: known pixels excluded as the organisers do)

config.selection: maximize min(DTI_gap, DTI_all) on the tuning fold among eligible candidates (robust to the proxy definition); tie-break lower prediction mass, then arm, floor, halo, tip
config.refit: fraction-consistent sampling: the refit keeps every exact positive and samples near/unlabeled strata at the SAME inclusion fractions used for the holdout model, so the class mixture does not drift (fix for Riftline's refit failure). Accept refit only if its full-grid support passes the gate AND is within a factor 1.5 of the holdout model's full-grid support; otherwise publish the unchanged holdout model.

portfolio.fusion: selected ML emission OR SGMC-gap traces (p=1)
portfolio.sgmc-gap: SGMC-gap traces only (pure hypothesis test; no model)

config.portfolio_rationale: SGMC is also the local proxy, so the value of adding SGMC traces directly CANNOT be measured locally without circularity. It is a leaderboard experiment: fusion minus ml isolates it.
config.score_warning: All local numbers use public catalogues, not hidden expert labels. No leaderboard score is implied.
